modes.name: association
modes.description: Association mode — filter the grid by a reference (baseType 'ref'). The widget's `datasource:` is the OPTION list (the associated entity), not the grid's own datasource; `Association:` names the reference on the grid entity and `CaptionAttribute:` is what each option shows. `linkedDs` (the grid's own list) is deliberately NOT mapped: the widget declares it isLinked, so the containing Data Grid 2 fills it. Measured on 11.6.6 — five Studio Pro-authored filters store it empty, this shape passes mx check at 0 errors, and a filter written WITH it still fails CE0642 "Property 'Datasource to Filter' is required". A definition mapping it is refused at build time.

modes.name: attribute
modes.description: Custom attribute — `attributes: [Attr]` names the ONE attribute the filter compares. DataWidgets 3.x stores it on `attr`, which the widget's editorConfig shows only when attrChoice is "linked" (Custom); it has no `attributes` list and no `defaultFilter`, the text filter's keys this mode used to write to, so the attribute was dropped (mendixlabs/mxcli#1519). This is the form a gallery's filter bar needs: there is no column to inherit an attribute from. More than one attribute is refused — the widget has a single slot.

modes.name: default
modes.description: Auto — no attribute given: the filter takes the attribute of the Data grid 2 column it sits in (attrChoice "auto"), so it only works inside a column.
